newsitem.title: USA: GRC mulls sale or merger-report.
newsitem.headline: GRC mulls sale or merger-report.

text.p: GRC International has hired an investment bank to examine the possibility of selling itself or merging with another company, the Washington Post reported Wednesday.
The newspaper said the move came as GRC faced declining revenues and a drop in its stock price of over 60 percent.
The declining stock price also prompted shareholder Frank Ciluffo, who owns 18.4 percent of the company's common stock, to tell executives he wants a seat on the board of directors, the Post said.
GRC said it would hire Smith Barney Inc. for advice on a variety of strategic options, including a merger, acquisition and additional investments to rejuvenate the company, the Post said.
